verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gumloop can version-track generated artifacts (files) and sync 'skills' with a GitHub repo, and auto-deploys hosted MCP servers on git push, but there is no documentation of versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the automations/agents themselves (their workflow logic, triggers, or configurations). missing for 10: automation/workflow version history, diff/review UI for automation changes, and a rollback mechanism for agent definitions.
